Commentary.Commentary: We are back with the chase. Monank Patel and Steven Taylor walk out as the opening pair for USA. Mahmudullah will bowl the first over of the run chase.
... The Run Chase ...

The bowling from USA was good in patches. The side struggled a bit in the field and with the extras but they did well not to let Bangladesh run away with the game in the first inning itself. Steven Taylor was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up a couple and gave away just 9 runs off his three overs. Jessy Singh, Ali Khan and Saurabh Netravalkar took one each as well. The wicket is two-paced and the outfield too is not the quickest. Can USA create history and chase this down? We shall find out with the chase in a while.

After being asked to bat first the Bangladesh innings got off to a steady start but lost in the later half of the powerplay. The side managed to score just 37 in the first six overs and lost a couple on its way. Wickets kept tumbling as Bangladesh were four down at just 68 runs after 11.2 overs and the side needed a spark from somewhere to motor along. Towhid Hridoy along with Mahmudullah knitted a much-needed partnership of 67 from 47 and helped the side post a formidable total. Towhid Hridoy was the pick of the batters for his half-century while Mahmudullah too played a good hand of 31 runs. Litton Das and Soumya Sarkar started well but failed to capitalize. Jaker Ali came in late and scored quickly as well.
A solid 5th wicket stand between Towhid Hridoy and Mahmudullah helps Bangladesh post 153 on board after the completion of 20 overs.
OUT! 17 runs off the final over. A full toss on leg. Hridoy looks to sweep but miscues it high and to point where Steven Taylor takes a dolly. Bangladesh end with 153/6.

Bangladesh, on the flip side, played a five-match series against Zimbabwe and won it by a margin of 4-1. Tanzid Hasan was the top-scorer for the visiting side in his debut series while Towhid Hridoy, Mahmudullah, and Jaker Ali found handy runs in the middle order. Taskin Ahmed, their leading wicket-taker in the previous series, will miss the three games against the USA owing to an injury. This will present Hasan Mahmud and Shoriful Islam to show their skills and press a case in the XI for the World Cup. Bangladesh starts as favourites for the series but can the USA spring a surprise and take an early lead in the series? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit. Stay tuned!

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the three-match series between Bangladesh and the USA from the Prairie View Cricket Complex in Houston, Texas. As we lead up to the T20 World Cup in a couple of weeks from now, the teams will be trying to find their best combination ahead of the mega event. The home side, the USA are coming off winning a series against Canada where skipper Monank Patel was the highest run-scorer for his side. The likes of Andries Gous, Steven Taylor, Harmeet Singh, Nitish Kumar, and Shadley van Schalkwyk had an excellent series and they will hope to keep the form going. USA will want their other players like Corey Anderson and Aaron Jones to find some form heading into the global tournament.
…MATCHDAY…

With the T20 World Cup looming on the horizon, international fixtures intensify as two teams face off one last time before the all-important tournament. The spotlight is now on the USA, who host Bangladesh for a three-match T20I series. This series could be a significant opportunity for both teams to acclimate to the conditions and make final adjustments to their squads ahead of the T20 World Cup. The first match is set to unfold at the Prairie View Cricket Complex in Texas. Led by Monank Patel, the USA enters this series on the back of a commanding 4-0 victory against Canada, showcasing their absolute best. The team boasts a strong and well-equipped lineup, with a formidable batting unit led by Steven Taylor, Andries Gous, Aaron Jones and Corey Anderson. The bowling unit has also been consistently impressive, featuring Harmeet Singh, Shadley van Schalkwyk, Nosthush Kenjige and Saurabh Netravalkar. Despite Bangladesh being the favourites, this USA side could prove to be a formidable force with their cohesive performance. On the other hand, Bangladesh arrives after a dominant 4-1 series victory against Zimbabwe, with their only setback coming in the final game. Najmul Hossain Shanto's side has been a force to reckon with both bat and ball and will look to make the most of this series to acclimate to the playing conditions. The top order has been consistent, but it is the middle-order firepower that truly makes the difference, with Towhid Hridoy and Jaker Ali in excellent form. Although the team will miss Taskin Ahmed, who was injured in the previous series, the bowling unit remains lethal with Mustafizur Rahman, Mahedi Hasan and Shoriful Islam leading the attack. With a lot at stake, this three-match T20I series promises to be an exciting and closely contested affair. Who do you reckon will get through in the first game? We shall soon find out!
